section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants in a single study conducted in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The initial sample of 660 women was reduced to 591 women (315 Malay women and 276 Chinese women) after excluding 69 non-Malay and non-Chinese participants. Malay women had a mean age of 42.96 years and mean BMI of 22.01, while Chinese women had a mean age of 43.18 years and mean BMI of 22.33.
